description: Scan an entire table or GSI/LSI, optionally applying a filter expression. Use query instead when you know the partition key. Use select=COUNT to get only Count and ScannedCount without items. Use Segment and TotalSegments for parallel scan.

exclusive_start_key.description: Exclusive start key for pagination, in DynamoDB JSON format

expression_attribute_names.description: Substitution tokens for expression attribute names

expression_attribute_values.description: Substitution tokens for expression attribute values, in DynamoDB JSON format

index_name.description: Name of a GSI or LSI to scan

limit.description: Maximum number of items to evaluate

projection_expression.description: Projection expression to limit returned attributes

return_consumed_capacity.description: What consumed capacity to return: TOTAL for the operation's total, INDEXES for the total broken down by table and index, or NONE (the default) for none. Figures follow DynamoDB's charging rules and match what the DynamoDB API returns for the same request.

segment.description: Segment number for parallel scan (0-based). Must be used with total_segments.

select.description: What to return: ALL_ATTRIBUTES (default), ALL_PROJECTED_ATTRIBUTES, COUNT, or SPECIFIC_ATTRIBUTES. When COUNT, the response contains only Count and ScannedCount (no items).

table_name.description: Name of the table to scan

total_segments.description: Total number of parallel scan segments (1 to 1000000). Must be used with segment.

name: scan
